quote: The prima facie speed limit shall be fifteen miles per hour when traversing a grade crossing of a steam, electric or any other motor railway, if during the last one hundred feet of the approach to such crossing the driver does not have a clear and unobstructed view of such crossing and of any traffic on such railway for a distance of four hundred feet in both directions along such railway. This Section shall not apply in the case of any railway grade crossing where a human flagman is on duty or clearly visible electrical or mechanical railway crossing signal device is installed but does not then indicate the immediate approach of a railway train or car.

activation.condition: Motor vehicle traverses a grade crossing of a steam, electric or other motor railway after the stated approach visibility condition.

obligation.description: Observe the fifteen mile per hour prima facie traversal speed limit when the source conditions apply; legal classification remains external.

exceptions.source_clause: where a human flagman is on duty

exceptions.trigger: clearly visible installed signal does not indicate immediate train or car approach
exceptions.source_clause: clearly visible electrical or mechanical railway crossing signal device is installed but does not then indicate the immediate approach of a railway train or car

timing.description: Assess crossing and railway traffic sight during the final one hundred feet of approach, and speed during traversal.

judgment_calls_needed.note: actual subject sight of crossing and rail traffic requires original source review

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: clearly visible electrical or mechanical railway crossing signal device
judgment_calls_needed.note: device visibility and indication require original per-frame review

parameter_refs.name: rail_sight_mode
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: reviewed left, right and crossing sight geometry

parameter_refs.name: rail_exception_state
